Customers may have observed errors in API platform requests, developer and embedded API requests, and UI requests, and some recipe trigger polls may have failed. The issue has since been resolved. Please contact Workato Support (https://support.workato.com) or your assigned CSM if you have any questions or require assistance regarding this event.

incidents.body: Between July 15, 2026, 11:16 AM UTC and July 20, 2026, 1:37 PM UTC, some recipe jobs that had been paused (waiting) for an extended period failed with an internal error when they resumed and called a recipe function. Affected jobs completed with an internal error instead of running successfully. A fix has been deployed and jobs are now processing normally. Please contact Workato Support (https://support.workato.com) or your assigned CSM if you have any questions or require assistance regarding this event.
